description: Original educational graph with data, skip, and control edges. Sparse section indices deliberately exercise stable source identities rather than list positions.

sections.title: Flow
sections.content: Input feeds Encoder through the encode edge. Encoder feeds Decoder through the features edge. Decoder feeds Output through the prediction edge. Input also feeds Decoder through a skip edge named residual. Controller sends a control edge named mode to Decoder.

sections.title: Grouping
sections.content: Encoder and Decoder belong to the Transform group. This routing example makes no performance claim.
